story.titleZh: FIA下周审理迈凯伦与红牛对摩纳哥大奖赛的上诉
story.summaryZh: 国际汽联（FIA）将于8月25日闭门审理迈凯伦和红牛对摩纳哥大奖赛恢复皮埃尔·加斯利领奖台决定的上诉。加斯利因两次维修区超速被罚时5秒跌至第七，复审后其第三名成绩被恢复，引发多支车队不满。

story.originalTitle: FIA to hear McLaren and Red Bull's Monaco GP appeal next week
story.summaryEn: The FIA will hear appeals from McLaren and Red Bull on 25 August against the decision to reinstate Pierre Gasly's podium at the Monaco Grand Prix. Gasly was demoted to seventh after two five-second penalties for pitlane speeding, but his third-place finish was reinstated following a right of review.
detailZh: FIA下周审理迈凯伦与红牛对摩纳哥大奖赛的上诉
两支车队对6月恢复皮埃尔·加斯利摩纳哥领奖台的决定提出上诉
兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦，皮埃尔·加斯利，阿尔派
下周，国际汽联（FIA）将审理迈凯伦和红牛对摩纳哥大奖赛恢复皮埃尔·加斯利领奖台决定的上诉。
这位阿尔派车手在6月7日以第三名冲线，但因两次维修区超速被罚时5秒，愤怒的加斯利最终跌至第七名，红牛的伊萨克·哈贾尔因此获得领奖台。
但这支法国车队立即提出复审请求，因为它有证据表明这位30岁车手并未超过60公里/小时的限速，甚至留出了额外余量以保持在限速以下。
在复审听证会上，FOM——F1的计时方——承认维修区用于计算速度的距离测量存在错误。
这导致平均速度被高估，因此赛会接受这一错误作为证据，认为加斯利的处罚应被撤销，其第三名成绩也应恢复。
因此，这位法国车手最终获得了职业生涯第六个领奖台，但这引发了各车队的愤怒，因为加斯利并非唯一因所谓维修区超速而受罚的车手。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利，伊萨克·哈贾尔，红牛车队，托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
唯一的不同之处在于，其他车手已在比赛中执行了处罚，这让各车队对阿尔派的抗议成功感到难以置信。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里尤其持有强烈意见，这位迈凯伦车手为执行处罚额外进站，导致他以第五名冲线，落后于加斯利和哈贾尔。
“我对这个决定感到非常震惊，”皮亚斯特里在巴塞罗那站后表示。
“当其他人因同样的事情受罚并在比赛中执行了处罚，你怎么能改变其中一个处罚，明知至少还有五六场比赛受到了影响，这太令人震惊了。”
乔治·拉塞尔可以说是受害最深的，这位梅赛德斯车手在进站时失去了潜在的领奖台位置——结果赛会认定他未正确执行处罚。
这导致他被罚通过维修区，这位争冠车手从前十跌至第12名，落后领跑车手积分榜的队友基米·安东内利68分。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦，伊萨克·哈贾尔，红牛车队
“我显然失去了位置，但我只能想象乔治的感受，”皮亚斯特里补充道。“我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。
“我因为执行处罚把位置输给了皮埃尔。理论上我应该是第三，但理论上乔治也应该是第三。
“整件事现在一团糟。他们给自己开了一个相当糟糕的先例。”
因此，迈凯伦和红牛对该决定提出上诉，而梅赛德斯则提出复审，但随后撤回，因为它几乎没有机会推翻拉塞尔的成绩。
数周以来，有关程序的消息一直沉寂，但FIA现已确认，其国际上诉法院将于8月25日星期二审理迈凯伦和红牛的上诉。
审理将在本周末荷兰大奖赛之后，于巴黎FIA总部闭门进行，这是2026年夏休期后的首场比赛。
detailEn: FIA to hear McLaren and Red Bull's Monaco GP appeal next week
The two teams have appealed against the decision to reinstate Pierre Gasly's Monaco podium from June
Lando Norris, McLaren, Pierre Gasly, Alpine
Next week, the FIA will hear the appeals from McLaren and Red Bull against the decision to reinstate Pierre Gasly’s podium at the Monaco Grand Prix.
The Alpine driver crossed the line in third on 7 June but two five-second penalties for pitlane speeding demoted a furious Gasly to seventh, handing Red Bull’s Isack Hadjar a podium.
But the French outfit immediately lodged a right of review bid because it had evidence that the 30-year-old had not exceeded the 60km/h limit and even took additional margin to stay below.
During the right of review hearing FOM - F1’s timekeeper - admitted that there had been an error with the distance measurement in the pitlane from which speeds were taken.
This caused average speeds to be over-reported and so stewards accepted the error as evidence that Gasly should have his penalties rescinded and thus, his third-place reinstated.
As such, the Frenchman finally secured his sixth career podium but this caused fury among teams, because Gasly wasn’t the only driver to be penalised for supposedly speeding in the pitlane.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing, Toto Wolff, Mercedes
The only difference was that other drivers had already served their penalties during the race, causing disbelief among teams that Alpine had been successful with its protest.
Oscar Piastri held a particularly strong opinion as the McLaren driver made an extra pitstop to serve his penalty, causing him to cross the finish line in fifth behind Gasly and Hadjar.
“I’m pretty mind-blown by the decision,” said Piastri at the following the Barcelona race.

“When other people have been penalised for the same thing and served a penalty in the race, how you can then change one penalty, knowing that at least five or six other races have been impacted by that, is astonishing.”
George Russell was arguably the hardest done by as the Mercedes driver lost a potential podium when he pitted - only for stewards to determine he hadn’t served the penalty correctly.
This resulted in a drive-through penalty that dropped the title contender out of the top 10 into 12th, causing him to fall 68 points behind his championship-leading team-mate Kimi Antonelli.
Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing
“I’ve obviously lost the position, but I can only imagine how George is feeling,” added Piastri. “I could not believe my eyes.
“I lost the position to Pierre because I served the penalty. Technically I should be P3, but then technically George should be P3.
“The whole thing is now a mess. It’s quite the precedent they’ve got themselves into.”

It therefore caused McLaren and Red Bull to appeal the decision, while Mercedes launched a right to review but subsequently withdrew that as it had little chance of getting Russell’s result overturned.
For weeks, news of the proceedings had gone quiet but the FIA has now confirmed that its International Court of Appeal will hear from McLaren and Red Bull on Tuesday 25 August.
This will take place behind closed doors at the FIA’s headquarters in Paris after this weekend’s Dutch Grand Prix, the first race since the 2026 summer shutdown.

其他同样因维修区超速受罚的车手已在比赛中执行处罚，包括奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里为受罚额外进站，最终以第五名完赛。
梅赛德斯曾提出复审但随后撤回，乔治·拉塞尔因处罚执行问题被罚通过维修区，跌至第12名。
keyPointsEn: FOM, F1's timekeeper, admitted during the right of review that there had been an error with the distance measurement in the pitlane from which speeds were taken, causing average speeds to be over-reported, and stewards accepted this as evidence that Gasly's penalties should be rescinded.
Other drivers penalised for pitlane speeding had already served their penalties during the race, including Oscar Piastri, who made an extra pitstop to serve his penalty and finished fifth.
Mercedes launched a right to review but subsequently withdrew it, while George Russell received a drive-through penalty for not serving his penalty correctly and dropped to 12th.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Cadillac F1 goes full Texas with new Tommy Hilfiger collection for US Grand Prix
relatedItems.summaryEn: The Cadillac Formula 1 Team and its partner Tommy Hilfiger have released a Texas-themed clothing collection ahead of the United States Grand Prix. The collection went on sale on Tuesday earlier this week.
detailZh: 凯迪拉克F1以全新汤米·希尔费格系列在美国大奖赛上尽显得克萨斯风情
凯迪拉克与汤米·希尔费格发布了一个以得克萨斯为灵感的五件式牛仔（denim）系列
瓦尔特利·博塔斯，凯迪拉克F1车队——图片由汤米·希尔费格提供
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计，以及让赛车超越运动本身的故事。
凯迪拉克一级方程式车队及其合作伙伴汤米·希尔费格在奥斯汀美国大奖赛前发布了一个德克萨斯主题的服装系列，这让我们所有人都兴奋不已。
汤米·希尔费格与凯迪拉克一级方程式车队的奥斯汀系列于本周二早些时候开售。但这并不是这两个品牌第一次推出与比赛相关的产品。他们已经在同一城市系列中推出了迈阿密和墨西哥系列，并且还计划在11月推出拉斯维加斯系列。
不出意外的话，牛仔布是这些单品的核心，它们带有镀铬细节和汤米·希尔费格红白蓝配色的V形美国国旗。
男士可以购买基于经典卡车司机风格的浅色水洗牛仔夹克。女士则有一件带银色箔涂层的牛仔背心。一件T恤、一件背心和一顶牛仔帽让这个系列更加让人难以拒绝。你知道还有什么同样让人难以拒绝吗？可以看到凯迪拉克车手瓦尔特利·博塔斯在日落时分向镜头举起一顶牛仔帽，背上印有V形旗帜图案。
你还需要什么来说服你？
瓦尔特利·博塔斯，凯迪拉克F1车队——由汤米·希尔费格提供
“在我们的美国根源上增添一点乐趣”
汤米·希尔费格首席设计官李·霍尔曼表示，设计师们从该品牌最受欢迎的两件单品入手。
他说：“我们从 Tommy 衣橱中的标志性单品——牛仔夹克和白 T 恤——入手，并研究了如何以奥斯汀的城市气质为灵感对它们进行重新演绎。”
“关键在于把熟悉的单品赋予全新的视角，同时坚守我们经典美式酷感的品牌基因。”
凯迪拉克一级方程式车队首席品牌顾问卡西迪·托里斯表示，在得克萨斯州举行的这场比赛让两个品牌都有了发挥空间。
“奥斯汀让我们有机会在美国根源上玩得更尽兴一些，”托里斯说，“这是为比赛周末打造的粉丝服饰，但设计上力求在围场之外也能长久穿着。”
汤米·希尔费格是凯迪拉克的官方服装和车迷服饰合作伙伴，车手塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯——博塔斯的队友——也是该品牌的全球男装大使。奥斯汀站是美国车队本赛季继五月初迈阿密大奖赛之后的第二个主场比赛，佩雷斯期待能在离家更近的地方驾驶。
“我们距离能够与前车竞争还差大约一秒到一秒半，我认为我们现在真正需要的是一辆更强的赛车，”佩雷斯在新加坡站后表示。“其他一切都在按预期推进，我相信我们作为一个团队会达到目标。我非常期待奥斯汀和墨西哥，我们的两场主场比赛。
“奥斯汀是车队的主场，墨西哥对我而言将格外特别，在家乡观众面前比赛并迎来第300场大奖赛。那将是一个非常特别的周末。”
凯迪拉克在首个赛季仍在等待它的首个积分。
detailEn: Cadillac F1 goes full Texas with new Tommy Hilfiger collection for US Grand Prix
Cadillac and Tommy Hilfiger have unveiled a five-piece denim collection inspired by Texas
Valtteri Bottas, Cadillac F1 team - courtesy of Tommy Hilfiger
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
The Cadillac Formula 1 Team and its partner Tommy Hilfiger have released a Texas-themed clothing collection ahead of the United States Grand Prix in Austin, and it's making us all kinds of excited.

The Tommy Hilfiger x Cadillac Formula 1 Team Austin collection went on sale on Tuesday earlier this week. But this isn't the first time the two brands have released something in connection with a race. They have already released Miami and Mexico collections in the same city series, and a Las Vegas drop is also planned for November.
Denim, maybe unsurprisingly, is the heart of these pieces, which carry chrome detailing and a chevron-shaped American flag in Tommy Hilfiger's red, white and blue.

Men can buy a light-wash denim jacket based on the classic trucker style. For women, there's a denim vest with a silver foil coating. A T-shirt, a tank top and a denim cap make the range even harder to say no to. And do you know what else does the same? Cadillac driver Valtteri Bottas can be seen tipping a cowboy hat to the camera at sunset, with the chevron flag design across his back.
What more do you need to persuade you?
Valtteri Bottas, Cadillac F1 team - courtesy of Tommy Hilfiger
"A little more fun with our American roots"
Lee Holman, Tommy Hilfiger's chief design officer, said the designers started with two of the brand's most popular pieces.
"We started with icons of the Tommy wardrobe – the denim jacket and the white T-shirt – and looked at how we could rework them inspired by the character of Austin," he said.
"It's about taking familiar pieces and giving them a fresh point of view, while staying grounded in our classic American cool DNA."
Cassidy Towriss, chief brand adviser for the Cadillac Formula 1 Team, said the race in Texas gave both brands room to play.
"Austin gives us a chance to have a little more fun with our American roots," Towriss said. "It's fanwear made for race weekend, but designed to live well beyond the paddock."

Tommy Hilfiger is Cadillac's official apparel and fanwear partner, with driver Sergio Perez, Bottas's team-mate, also the brand's global menswear ambassador. With the Austin race being the American team's second home race of the season after the Miami Grand Prix earlier this season in early May, Perez is looking forward to driving a little closer to home.

“We are still lacking around one to one-and-a-half seconds to be able to compete with the cars ahead, and I think what we really need now is a stronger car underneath us," Perez said following his Singapore campaign. "Everything else has been progressing as expected, and I’m confident we will get there as a team. I’m really looking forward to Austin and Mexico, our two home races.
"Austin for the team, and Mexico will be particularly special for me, racing in front of my home crowd and reaching 300 grands prix. It’s going to be a very special weekend.”
Cadillac is still waiting for its first points in its debut season.
